scope: All cases assert shared validity and recovery. Cases with declarations assert normalized component input modes, types, scalar defaults, bodyless/default signature markers, and byte ranges. Cases with states assert state names, variants, payload markers, payload fields, and byte ranges; cases with clauses assert render clause names, selectors, patterns with qualifiers, bindings with aliases, and byte ranges; cases with repetitions assert every Keyed Repetition in pre-order with its item, keywords, collection and key path parts, and byte ranges. Cases with records assert normalized record fields, optional markers, canonical types, and byte ranges; cases with imports assert import specifiers, aliases, and path ranges. Cases with interpolations assert normalized path shape and byte ranges; cases with segments assert normalized quoted literal/path segments. Cases with elements assert every body element in pre-order with its name range, depth, continuation-group marker, and attribute names and ranges; cases with conditions assert every condition node in pre-order with its if/else keyword ranges, else-if marker, and normalized condition tree; cases with slots assert every slot fill with its keyword, name, and whole ranges. Broader semantic equivalence is not asserted. Cases with markup assert every doctype, HTML comment, and raw-text literal in pre-order with its kind, range, and doctype name or text; cases with attributeConditions assert every conditional attribute group with its keyword ranges, condition tree, and branch attributes; cases with forwarding assert every spread path and attribute bag literal with its ranges and attributes. Cases with stories assert every story and fixture declaration with its component, name, keyword, argument, and body ranges and every value's kind, payload range, and nested fields or items.

cases.name: record and collection inputs with dotted paths
render clauses with bodyless and default signatures
keyed repetitions in element, default, and clause bodies
optional input cannot also have a default
default must be a scalar literal
default string escape must be valid
record field cannot have a default
record missing closing bracket before next record
render clause header rejects a trailing comma
qualified pattern needs a variant name
repetition path rejects a spaced separator
element lines, siblings, and continuation groups
content declarations, outlets, and slot fills
conditions with every operator and else-if
element body must start on the header line
parenthesized attribute list must follow the element name
double negation is not a condition
slot fill requires a braced body
framework attribute names, doctype, and HTML comments
colon chain is not an attribute
prefixed attribute name needs whitespace on a header line
doctype requires a name on its line
